english.title: Driver of goods vehicle fail to give owner name / address / produce insurance certificate after accident in public place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence in a public place namely, **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 andSchedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence on **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd nwyddau - methu rhoi enw/cyfeiriad perchennog/cyflwyno tyst yswiriant yn dilyn damwain mewn man cyhoeddus
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau’n unigolyn yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb mewn man cyhoeddus, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), ar gais swyddog heddlu neu archwilydd cerbydau, bu ichi fethu â rhoi eich enw a’ch cyfeiriad a chyflwyno y dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio o dan Ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd dan amheuaeth o fod yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb yn **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..).

Methodd y diffynnydd â rhoi

(A)_[ei new a’i gyfeiriad]_
(B)_[ei henw a’i chyfeiriad]_

i swyddog heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/i wneud hynny, a methodd â chyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer y cerbyd, pan ofynnwyd iddo/i wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu cyn pen saith diwrnod.
